frozen.scoring: Eventual success requires the expected outcome and, for an acted case, the expected opened ids in order and the expected state. close-photo and ids starting with photo may appear as one recovery and do not by themselves fail an acted case. Any other extra id fails. A numeric thread id that was not expected is a wrong thread and fails. A hold or wait succeeds only when nothing was opened. First-attempt success also requires the exact opened list, zero wrong clicks, and no second observation. Expected answers are not read by the navigation code.
